_comment: Passage-name -> {layout, progress, end_of_round_body, end_of_round_body2} map for --progress-map. One shared file at the Masterwork-Modules repo root (not nested under a single module) since it's keyed by passage name and may end up covering more than one module. Currently populated from The Cost of Disease only, derived from Assets/Scenes/Main.unity's PassageTracker MonoBehaviour (genHubEPassageList/genHubMPassageList/genHubLPassageList for layout, progress: table for progress and end_of_round_body/end_of_round_body2 -- English/index-0 strings from each entry's Details[0]/details2[0], the text ViewEndOfRound.SetEndOfRound shows in its acknowledgement popup) plus the user's correction that the game is 3 generations x 3 rounds (Early/Middle/Late Years) = 9 monotonic progress steps -- the raw Unity progress table's '0' entries for Late-round passages were a reference-app quirk (ViewEndOfRound only writes its stored fraction when CompletedRound > 0), not a real semantic value; this map stores the real 1-9 step directly. TIMING: the extractor emits an end_of_round popup (layout: end_of_round, okay: 'End of Round', target = the CheckProgress call's next-passage argument, onclose = the _ProgressRound assign) in place of the link that LEAVES the mapped hub passage (matching where CheckProgress is actually called in the source), not on hub entry -- so _ProgressRound reflects rounds completed so far (0 while playing round 1, reaching a given round's own mapped value only after the player has already clicked past it and dismissed the popup), and only becomes 9 once the player leaves round 9's hub on the way into end-of-game/scoring, not while round 9 is still being played. The two legacy stray entries (University1OLD/Prosperity3b) have no progress/end-of-round fields at all -- layout override only.
